topic: How to Build an Ongoing Relationship With Your Broker
objective: Frame the broker relationship as an ongoing resource, not a one-off transaction.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A broker relationship doesn't need to end once a facility settles. Ongoing contact means your broker understands your business as it evolves, and can flag opportunities or review existing facilities as circumstances change.

caption:
It's easy to think of a broker relationship as a one-off transaction, but the real value often builds over time — a broker who understands your business's history and trajectory can respond faster and more usefully to future needs.

Keeping in touch periodically, rather than only reaching out when a need is urgent, tends to lead to better outcomes down the track.
